definitions.trace_length: Line events in the program's own code while running it once on its input: each execution of a line counts, so a loop body counts once per iteration. Functions and methods: only the call is traced, not the definitions or the setup; Avatar scripts: the whole script. Use it only where output_matches is true.
definitions.output_matches: Whether the run reproduced the reference output: CRUXEval return values as Python values, RE2 return values as recorded JSON (other objects by repr), Avatar printed output as text or number.
definitions.decoded_inputs: RE2 only: whether the reproducing run decoded input strings that are Python literals of another type (RE2 records e.g. complex numbers as strings).
definitions.execution_status: ok, timeout, error (the program raised; detail has the last error line) or no_harness (not executed: RE2 library code).
